definitions.primary: Last agent message parsed using saved regex -> requested native user operation(s). Executed iff matching tool call and arguments has native non-error tool result and requested mutation target holds after block. Primary deviation = none of these requested operations executed AND question/clarification marker in user speech. Also report zero-any-tool and missing-first-operation variants. This is a mechanical feature, not an intention label.
definitions.multi_step: Any requested operation, first requested operation, and all requested operations reported separately. First instruction is primary next step; later reboot/test are separate substeps. Conditional VPN/DataSaver contingencies at s008 are not required unconditionally; generic try-internet/mobile-data mapped to native run_speed_test, explicitly documented.
definitions.no_action_request: N/A, never label ordinary non-action as noncompliance. Purchases use user numeric consent rather than user tool calls: refuel_data is an agent tool.
definitions.quantity: First add/full1GB or2GB amount is current consent; later conditional remainingGB separate. Offered up-to2GB is not a mandate to buy2GB; evaluator exact2GB assertion is reported separately from real connectivity.
definitions.comparison: Six original paired native q draws (exclude own candidate when candidate originates from q) and16independent B1 native-reference branch blocks separately. Do not pool batches or count suffix repeats as reply draws. Mechanical outcome association within16native suffixes; candidate treatment shift verified by previous retest does not isolate a single feature.
definitions.claims: No new causal effect estimate for a feature; observational suffix associations describe paths. DB/card/tool records, no human labels and no LLM judgments used for new features.

question_marker_regex: \?|\b(?:could you|can you|should i|will it|what should|where should|please (?:tell|explain|clarify))\b
